Compliance.EInvoiceNote: Businesses with annual sales under RM3 million are not required to issue e-Invoices from 1 Sep 2026. The threshold has changed several times; verify with HASiL.
Compliance.PersonalFilingNote: Form BE (no business income) is usually due 30 April and Form B 30 June of the following year.
